text:
marta: Quick question — I need to hand off today's runtime unpin (runtime v2.15 -> v2.16) to someone in APAC. I'm traveling and won't be available for the 02:00 UTC window. Can @alice take delegation?

alice: I can take it if we add a strict canary + kill-switch. Conditions: 5% canary, 30m observation, automatic rollback on error rate > 1.5x baseline, and re-run preflight after the SDK patch lands. :+1:

deploybot: preflight summary for unpin runtime:v2.16
  - compat-check: PASS (model bindings)
  - sdk-compat: WARNING (SDK 3.1.1 -> recommended 3.1.2 due to method rename)
  - kv-cache smoke: PASS
  - infra-health: GREEN
  To proceed run: `/deploy unpin runtime:v2.16 --canary 5% --window 02:00-03:00 --rollback-on errors`

bob: heads-up — infra has scheduled storage maintenance at 02:30 UTC in eu-west which could skew metrics during canary. Can we shift to 03:30-04:30?

sre-bot: snapshot metrics from last 24h (eu-west): p50: 24ms, p95: 88ms, errors: 0.08%. Maintenance window at 02:30 may produce transient 0.3% error blips. Recommendation: avoid overlapping maintenance for clean canary signal.

dan: there's a tiny SDK API rename in 3.1.2 that fixes a response-parsing edgecase. I opened a hotfix PR (link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/842). If we don't have 3.1.2, some internal clients may see a decode warning (non-fatal).

alice: OK — proposal: wait for PR merge and a quick CI green, then deploy at 03:30-04:00 UTC (shorter window). Conditions enforced: 
  1) deploybot re-runs preflight and shows sdk-compat PASS
  2) canary = 5%, observe 30m telemetry
  3) rollback if error rate > 1.5x baseline OR token-latency p95 increases by >30%
  4) release notes updated with the unpin and the SDK note (marta?)

marta: I will merge the PR and update release notes. I'll tag the PR with `release-unpin` and ping here when CI is green. Also adding a short note in the Console release page about the canary.

deploybot: acknowledged. Standing by to re-run preflight. Current scheduled action: HOLD until `deploybot preflight` returns all PASSes. Use `/deploy hold release:v2.16` to keep the hold.

alice: Thanks — if CI passes ping me and I'll flip the delegation and start the orchestrated rollout. If anything looks off I will trigger `rollback immediate` and notify oncall. :rotating_light:

marta: CI is green, merged PR `hotfix/sdk-3-1-2` — tagging now. Updating release notes + Console blurb.

deploybot: preflight re-run: sdk-compat: PASS, compat-check: PASS, infra-health: GREEN. Scheduling unpin for 03:30-04:00 UTC with canary 5%. Rollback policy attached.

bob: noted. I'll keep extra eyes on eu-west so we can separate infra blips from runtime regressions.

sre-bot: monitoring pinned. Will post a short postmortem if we hit rollback.

marta: thanks everyone. leaving delegation to @alice for the window. I'll verify release notes post-deploy. :pray:
